busy.title: Printer busy
busy.hint: Another P12 program is printing right now. Wait a moment or close the other program.

unreachable.title: Printer unreachable
unreachable.hint: Is the printer off or asleep? Turn it on. Is the phone app connected? Only one host can connect at a time, so disconnect it there.

not_paired.title: Printer not paired
not_paired.hint: Pair the printer in the Windows Bluetooth settings, then run 'tapesmith setup'.

locked.title: File locked
locked.hint: Another P12 program is writing right now. Wait a moment and try again.

incomplete.title: Print incomplete
incomplete.hint: The connection was lost while printing (battery empty? printer off?). Check the printer and print the label again (tapesmith reprint last).

busy.title: COM port in use
busy.hint: Another program is holding the port (phone app, old phomemo tool, terminal). Close it or turn the printer off and on again.

missing.title: COM port missing
missing.hint: Pair the printer in the Windows Bluetooth settings or run 'tapesmith setup'.

lost.title: Bluetooth connection lost
lost.hint: The printer is off or out of range. Turn it on, move closer and try again.

error.title: Print service not responding
error.hint: Restart the print service (tapesmith daemon restart) and try again.

invalid.title: Invalid label
invalid.hint: The label contains invalid data. Check its objects and try again.

error.title: Invalid print data
error.hint: The print data does not match the printer. Check the tape and settings.

missing.title: Credentials missing
missing.hint: The secret reference points to an empty or missing entry. Check the settings.

not_printable.title: Label cannot be printed
not_printable.hint: Shorten the content, choose another tape or follow the preview warnings.

invalid.title: Invalid value
invalid.hint: Check your input and try again.

invalid.title: Invalid request
invalid.hint: Check your input and try again.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.hint: This entry no longer exists. Reload the list.

required.title: Sign-in required
required.hint: Reopen the app from the tray icon or with 'tapesmith web'.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.hint: This feature is not available for this access level.

not_allowed.title: Action not allowed
not_allowed.hint: Reload the app. If that does not help, update the print service.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.hint: This entry was changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.

too_large.title: Too large
too_large.hint: Make the file or content smaller and try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.hint: Wait a moment and try again.

error.title: Error
error.hint: Try again. If the error persists, run 'tapesmith doctor'.

token_missing.title: Token missing
token_missing.hint: Add the token for this integration in the settings.

not_configured.title: Integration not set up
not_configured.hint: Enter the address and credentials in the settings.

unreachable.title: Service unreachable
unreachable.hint: Check the network and the service address.

auth_failed.title: Sign-in to the service failed
auth_failed.hint: Check the token or credentials in the settings.

upstream.title: Service error
upstream.hint: The connected service reported an error. Try again later.

not_installed.title: Not installed
not_installed.hint: Updates are only available for the installed version. Install Tapesmith first.

no_trusted_key.title: No update key
no_trusted_key.hint: This version contains no trusted key. Install the update manually.

source_invalid.title: Invalid update source
source_invalid.hint: Check the update source in the settings (github:owner/repo, file:folder or https address).

source_unreachable.title: Update source unreachable
source_unreachable.hint: Check the network and the update source, then try again later.

signature_invalid.title: Invalid signature
signature_invalid.hint: The update is not trusted and was discarded.

checksum_mismatch.title: Checksum mismatch
checksum_mismatch.hint: The download is damaged. Check for updates again.

download_failed.title: Download failed
download_failed.hint: Check the network and try again.

busy.title: Update not possible right now
busy.hint: A print job or another update is running. Try again later.

apply_failed.title: Update failed
apply_failed.hint: The previous version was restored. Create a support report and send it in.

unavailable.title: Barcode decoder unavailable
unavailable.hint: zxing-cpp could not be loaded (for example blocked by Windows Smart App Control). Enter the serial number by hand, printing still works.

disabled.title: Module turned off
disabled.hint: Turn it on under Settings > Modules or with “tapesmith module enable <module>”.

internal.title: Error
internal.hint: Unexpected error. Try again, otherwise create a support report.

offline.title: Print service unavailable
offline.hint: Is the print service running? Start it with "tapesmith daemon start".

bad_response.title: Unexpected response from the print service
bad_response.hint: Reload the app. If the error persists, restart the print service.
